title: Speaker training dataset snapshot
description: Frozen ordered membership in current embedded recording evidence. A current-document or known-speaker mapping correction invalidates dependent membership and retires assignment-bearing manifests/preparations while retaining noncontent lineage.

schema_version.description: Version of this portable document contract.

kind.description: Discriminator identifying an immutable speaker training dataset snapshot.

workspace_id.description: Workspace owning the snapshot and every referenced member.

speaker_id.description: Originating catalog speaker for this selected corpus.

speaker_identity_revision.description: Exact identity revision used when selecting this speaker's corpus.

catalog_revision.description: Catalog revision against which selection was resolved.

created_at.description: UTC instant when this snapshot was frozen.

manifest_sha256.description: Current assignment-bearing manifest digest, or null after invalidation.

manifest_artifact.description: Current managed manifest, or null after retirement/invalidation.

selection.description: Complete frozen selection recipe and effective filters.

preparation.description: Current preparation recipe, or null after invalidation.

members.description: Ordered included segment memberships; empty snapshots represent no matching corpus and do not imply runnable training.

exclusions.description: Frozen excluded-segment decisions and their technical or user-supplied reasons.

summary.description: Frozen corpus totals and diagnostic summary.

extensions.description: Namespaced dataset metadata preserved without altering immutable membership.

state.description: Whether current evidence still authorizes this frozen corpus. Invalidated lineage has no executable manifest or membership.

selection.description: Exact effective selection recipe, allowing automatic corpus selection without segment-by-segment approval.

preset_version.description: Version defining the chosen preset's behavior.

attribution_bases.description: Allowed assignment bases; an empty array includes every declared basis.

source_asset_ids.description: Optional source filter; an empty array covers the speaker's whole workspace corpus.

languages.description: Optional language filter; an empty array is language-independent.

minimum_duration_us.description: Minimum original segment duration considered by this recipe.

anyOf.description: Maximum original segment duration considered by this recipe.

maximum_duration_us.description: Upper segment-duration bound, or null when no upper bound is configured.

explicitly_excluded_segment_ids.description: User-selected exclusions applied automatically to this snapshot.

options.description: Adapter-specific filters and quality thresholds validated by the selected preset/adapter.

extensions.description: Namespaced custom selection rules with documented adapter interpretation.

preparation.description: Frozen requested preparation contract; final prepared bytes are bound by a separate immutable preparation manifest.

contract_version.description: Version of the preparation request/result contract.

adapter_version.description: Version of the selected adapter implementation.

options.description: Exact audio preparation options without credentials or temporary paths.

transcript_required.description: Whether this training input requires selected transcript and alignment references.

output_format.description: Requested audio format, or null when the adapter consumes source streams directly.

anyOf.description: Requested prepared sample rate in hertz.

sample_rate_hz.description: Requested sample rate, or null when unchanged or not applicable.

channel_count.description: Requested output channel count, or null when unchanged or not applicable.

member.description: Reference-only frozen membership. Resolve against current recording authority before preparation; a superseded digest invalidates this corpus.

recording_id.description: Current recording owning the embedded Cueson evidence.

document_digest.description: Exact current embedded document digest; stale references fail resolution.

cue_id.description: Cue identity inside the current embedded document.

local_speaker_id.description: Recording-scoped local speaker token occurring in this cue attribution.

source_digest.description: Exact canonical audio content digest resolved for this current reference.

source_map_digest.description: Exact canonical source-clock mapping digest resolved for this current reference.

mapping_revision.description: Revision of the independent manual mapping used for this current reference.

exclusion.description: One explicit selection exclusion retained for explainable automatic corpus selection.

segment_id.description: Stable segment excluded from this snapshot.

segment_revision.description: Segment revision evaluated by this decision.

reason_codes.description: Declared reasons for exclusion, such as duplicate-source-span or configured-overlap-filter.

method.description: Preset/adapter or user action responsible for the decision.

method_version.description: Version of the method when this exclusion was computed.

details.description: Nonsecret diagnostic values and effective thresholds explaining the decision.

summary.description: Totals frozen when selection completes; the application verifies consistency against membership.

source_asset_count.description: Distinct original source assets represented by included members.

original_duration_us.description: Sum of selected original intervals in integer microseconds after the recorded deduplication policy.

anyOf.description: Known prepared duration in integer microseconds.

prepared_duration_us.description: Known prepared duration, or null until preparation is materialized.

excluded_segment_count.description: Number of excluded segment decisions retained in this snapshot.

diagnostic_counts.description: Counts keyed by declared technical diagnostic code.

languages.description: Language identifiers observed or selected for the included corpus.

state.description: Evidence-state condition selecting current or invalidated lineage.

members.description: Invalidated corpora have no executable memberships.

manifest_sha256.description: Assignment-bearing digest is cleared after invalidation.

manifest_artifact.description: Assignment-bearing artifact is cleared after invalidation.

preparation.description: Assignment-bearing preparation is cleared after invalidation.
